|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' compared with the previous version (the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021; left = before, right = after): [[File:V9-D-mustafarvaderscastle_ai-2022-01-15-vs-hires-2021-08-10-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
